replica_rule: replica r: numpy default_rng(r) bootstrap of the 30 train files (counts in the closed form; theta on the first n_sub distinct drawn files); validation and test fixed
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
title: Off-axis triplet table as a sum of S chirps (H1) and its fast evaluation by recurrences (H2)
question: H1: can the off-axis coefficient table of A1 be replaced by S <= 5 chirps C(m,n) = sum A_s exp(i m n / eta_s) T_s(|m|+|n|) (<= 20 parameters) without losing BER? H2: how many RM does the recurrence evaluation of one chirp cost versus the table?

bases.A1_M8_nc31: E046 A1 varpro M8 N_c31 (saved theta per replica)
bases.A1_M11_nc63: E048 A1 varpro M11 N_c63 (saved theta per replica)

variants.chirp_complex: A_s complex (4 real parameters per chirp with free W)
variants.chirp_joint_imag: S in (3,5): FIR, alpha, eta, W jointly by L-BFGS on 4 files, A on 30
variants.random_imag: (iv) random eta (log-uniform |eta| in [1,50], random sign), W uniform in [2, 4M]
variants.radial: (iii) K hat functions of sqrt(m^2+n^2), K in (2,3,5,8,12), 2K real parameters
variants.lowrank: (iii) ordered C = sum_{j<=r} u_j v_j^T symmetrized, r in (1,2,3), 4 Q r real parameters (Q = 2M index values; far more than 3S, reported as is)

tuning.chirp: greedy grid eta (60 values, both signs, |eta| in [0.5, 63]) x W (12 values in [2, 50]) per added chirp, then joint L-BFGS-B over all (eta, log W) on the Gram matrix of the 4 theta files; evaluations counted in tuning_evals
tuning.lambda: 6 values (E046 grid) by validation BER for every variant, the same for all

unit_checks.recurrence: quadrants A, A' (recurrence) + B (pair table, prefix sums) equal to the direct sum: 3e-16 ... 5e-14, domains T3 and box

table_fit_1a: e053_table_fit on saved tables (middle lambda 1e-4, replica r17): results/table_fit.csv, figures/E053_heatmap_*.png (run locally before the rule: no data, existing coefficients)

rm.project: table: 12 RM per merged off-axis term + Kerr 4L + 2 + (N_c+1)/2 + 4
rm.oc_reuse: Optics Continuum 4(12) 2896 sec. 3.3.3 adapted to one polarization: 8 RM per term + 4 RM per new double product (2M lags)
rm.fast: chirp_triplets.rm_fast_chirp: unfold 4, quadrants A/A' 4(K+1) + 6(K-1) each, B 6(2M-1) + 4(2M-1), refold 4, amplitude 4; exp from a table 0 RM (column with the exp computed by a running phasor: +8); additions reported separately

rule_draft.h1_confirmed: for one of chirp_complex / chirp_imag / chirp_joint_imag with S <= 5 and <= 20 real parameters: mean test (5 replicas) lower than (i) by less than std(i); both significance rules (2 SE, 2 std) reported
rule_draft.h1_rejected: at S = 8 every chirp variant is worse than (i) by more than 2 SE AND more than 2 std
rule_draft.physical_uniqueness: chirp_imag beats radial (iii) at the nearest number of parameters by > 2 SE and > 2 std; otherwise the chirp form is only a small-parameter form, not unique
rule_draft.splits: the best chirp configuration (by validation) on the 3 E023 splits: the same sign of (chirp - full) on all 3
rule_draft.stop: H1 rejected -> task 3 is not run; task 2A is done anyway; 2B only if H1 confirmed or within 2 std of (i)
rule_draft.limits: one channel, one polarization, 1 sps, one stage (A1), spread over bootstrap replicas of the train files

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: H1 + H2 make the triplet layer O(S M) instead of O(M^2)
value_filter.answered_in_literature: chirp form: Xiao 2025 Property 7 (one stage); fast evaluation: Optics Continuum 2025 mentions only the potential

decision_if_positive: 2B: recurrence in the best model, RM comparison at 430/820/1200 with DBP (E028), DBP-X (E050), A1
decision_if_negative: report as is; the table stays
